```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(mgcv)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("481_EML_AK_CiPEHR_CO2_2009-2011.csv")

summary(raw_data)
head(raw_data)

```

```{r}
raw_data$treatment <- paste(raw_data$WW, raw_data$SW)

new_data <- raw_data %>%
  dplyr::select(year, doy, fence, NEE_g, treatment) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NEE_g)) %>% 
  group_by(year, doy, fence, treatment) %>%
  summarise(NEE = sum(NEE_g)) %>%
  group_by(year, fence, treatment) %>%
  summarise(NEE = sum(NEE))

new_data
write.csv(new_data, "481_EML_AK_CiPEHR_CO2_2009-2011_Processed.csv")
```
